Scene:
古代的时候有一个人叫神农。他需要当上医，一看别的人就想帮助他们。但是，他有一个问题，他不知道什么东西能做药。神农听说一个远远的地方有一种植物，什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好。神农三个月走去，找到有植物的地方，他看到一个很漂亮的植物，又香又好看。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 他需要当上医：医生
- 一看别的人就想帮助他们：看到，看look vs.看到see; 病人，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”
- 什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好：吃了以后
- 神农三个月走去：走了三个月

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: 一看：一看到，The verb 看 means “look”; when Shen Nong sees someone, the resultative complement 到 is needed. [rule: resultative_complement]
Run 2: 一看：一看到，看 describes looking, while 看到 expresses the result of seeing someone. [rule: resultative_complement]
Run 3: 一看：一看到，The meaning is “see someone and then want to help,” so the perception has a result and needs the resultative complement 到. [rule: resultative_complement]

output.reason: All runs identify 一看 as the same look-versus-see error and correctly revise it to 一看到.
